text:
maria-pm: quick sync — i posted a PRD draft for the 'runtime roadmap slice' we promised to sales. need to decide scope for the Q3 rollout: full KV eviction + new attn kernel, or phased (kv-only then kernel). customers pushing for <50ms tail for short prompts. https://redwood.internal/prd/2077773141
chen-eng: skimmed the doc. two big risk areas: (1) attn kernel changes touch memory layout -> longer testing, (2) kv eviction semantics could break long-chat regressions.
aj-eng: +1 on both. for the short latency ask, KV prefetch + prefix caching seems highest ROI. kernel change buys throughput for long contexts, less effect on 8-32 token tails.
maria-pm: that matches my read. sales (Caravel) explicitly asked for 50ms tails for 0-64 tokens otherwise they won't sign dedicated.
tess-ml: can we quantify rollback cost for kernel change? if rollback requires model recompile, it's a big ops window. need acceptance criteria that include graceful fallback to existing kernels.
ben-sre: must have canary + automatic fallback policy. propose rollout plan: 1) deploy kv-prefetch to 10% serving pool, monitor latency P50/P95/P99, error rates; 2) if stable at 10% -> 50% -> kernel canary on small capacity with strict circuit-breaker.
sam-product: from GTM perspective phased is easier. but enterprise deal is time-sensitive. what's the delta in implementation effort?
chen-eng: rough numbers: kv-prefetch + eviction tune = ~3 sprints (6 weeks) for full QA and canaries. attn kernel refactor = another 3-4 sprints + kernel validation matrix (quant + fp16 paths).
aj-eng: also need perf matrix: run across seq lenses {32,256,1024}, batch sizes {1,8,32} and GPU types. we should lock the eval harness now.
maria-pm: ok propose we scope Q3 MVP = KV prefetch + conservative eviction policy + rollout gating. Q4 target = attn kernel opt and kernel-selector polish. need to align acceptance criteria in the PRD.
tess-ml: draft AC suggestions below (copied):
```
Acceptance Criteria (MVP - KV slice):
- End-to-end deployed with config toggle `runtime.kv_prefetch.enabled = true`
- Observed median tail latency improvement >= 15% for 0-64 token requests in canary region
- No increase in model output divergence > 0.5% vs baseline (BLEU/ROUGE or other eval)
- KV cache eviction policy respects customer pinning flags and doesn't evict pinned keys during active sessions
- Canary rollback completes within 5 minutes via automated circuit-breaker if errors > 0.1% or P99 regresses > 25%
```
maria-pm: those look good. add a requirement: cost delta per token must be < 10% for hosted customers, otherwise pricing conversation.
ben-sre: add infra AC: migration scripts for cache metadata must be idempotent, tested on staging. also capture disk/ram footprint delta.
chen-eng: for attn kernel PRD (Q4) add acceptance items: kernel selector fallback table, recompile-free soft fallback when possible, and knobbed quant-path tests.
aj-eng: question about fallback: soft fallback might add 2-5ms per request. is that acceptable during incidents?
sam-product: acceptable if we can document toggle and set SLOs for degraded performance windows. customers prefer predictable degradation to silent failures.
tess-ml: we should enumerate edge cases: partially filled KV (prefix mismatch), pinned keys across model variants, and mixed-quant models in routing. add those to PRD.
maria-pm: i'll update PRD with these ACs and edge cases. can everyone review before EOD Friday so we can lock scope for the sprint?
chen-eng: will review, leaving notes on the perf harness config.
aj-eng: I'll drop the perf matrix and a small repro script in the doc. example snippet for rolling config: 
```
rollout:
  kv_prefetch:
    strategy: gradual
    steps: [0.1, 0.5, 1.0]
    health_checks:
      latency_p99_increase_pct: 20
      error_rate_threshold: 0.001
  kernel_canary:
    enabled: false # Q4
    max_nodes: 4
    fallback_on_error: true
```
ben-sre: deploy-bot: starting canary gate, tagging logs.
deploy-bot: Canary pipeline triggered for kv_prefetch at 10% in us-east-1. Build id: build-2077773141-a.
maria-pm: thanks. if we agree on phased approach i'll update the launch checklist and notify GTM. we should capture one customer-facing performance graph to include in the sales deck.
sam-product: i'll own the slide if eng provides a stable canary run.
tess-ml: last thing — we need an eval that checks generation quality after KV prefetch (prompt-injection style edge cases). i'll add a small eval set.
chen-eng: note: schedule a cross-team review with platform & sops for the kernel change; kernel affects memory accounting for Dedicated.
maria-pm: noted. deadline: finalize PRD + ACs by Friday EOD. if any blockers call a quick sync tomorrow 10:30am.
aj-eng: ok. tagging @tess-ml for the eval and @ben-sre for canary playbook updates.
ben-sre: will update playbook and add rollback runbook steps.
maria-pm: thanks all — locking this thread as the source of truth for scope negotiation. will send updated link when done.
